title: MO OS
tagline: Six concepts for a customizable personal dashboard.
stateNote: Design concepts that run in the browser. The data shown is sample data.
problem: A to-do app, a calendar and a budget tool rarely share one screen. MO OS explores six ways to lay out a personal daily cockpit.
audience: People who want one place for their day.
contribution: It is my project. I haven't linked a public repository for it.
worksToday: Six layouts: Personal OS, Spatial Desktop, Mission Control, Card Deck and AI-First, among others, per the site.
Widgets can be added and rearranged.
limitations: The numbers and events shown are sample data.
These are concepts, not a finished app.

media.alt: The MO OS Personal OS layout with daily focus, active projects and a money snapshot.
media.caption: The home screen of the hosted build.

involve.headline: Want your own dashboard?
asks: Tell me which layout you'd actually use.
